rules.title: Rules of this market
rules.lead: These are real trading rules, simplified for class. Breaking them brings a warning from the staff.

cartel.title: Do not agree on prices (no cartels)
cartel.body: Agreeing with another $t(terms.organization) to set the same price is not allowed. Decide your price yourself.
cartel.example: For example: deciding "let us all sell at 1,000 MP"

marketSplit.title: Do not divide the market between you
marketSplit.body: Agreeing among $t(terms.organizations) that "only we sell here" is also not allowed.
marketSplit.example: For example: deciding "only company A sells in this area"

circular.title: Do not trade just to move money around
circular.body: Buying and selling with nothing real behind it is not allowed. Only the numbers grow; nothing is actually sold.
circular.example: For example: A buys from B, B buys from C, and C buys from A

favoritism.title: Do not buy only because you are friends
favoritism.body: Buying from a friend cannot be forbidden. But the imbalance shows up in the numbers. Be ready to explain why the product is useful to you.

watching.title: What is visible
watching.body: The mutual trade rate between $t(terms.organizations), and how concentrated your buying is, appear on the $t(terms.administrator) screen. Purchases by $t(terms.administrators) are shared among $t(terms.administrators) too.

rules.penalty: When a trade looks doubtful, we ask the people involved first. The system never punishes anyone on its own.

tutorial.title: Getting started
tutorial.lead: Four steps, and you can both sell and buy.

step1.title: 1. Create your $t(terms.organization)
step1.body: A name and a password are enough. Write down the ID and recovery code shown to you. They are never shown again.

step2.title: 2. List a product
step2.body: Write who it is for and what problem it solves. If that does not come across, it will not sell.

step3.title: 3. Buy from another $t(terms.organization)
step3.body: Pick one from the market. You cannot buy your own. The MP you pay goes to the other $t(terms.organization).

step4.title: 4. Look at your business
step4.body: Revenue, expenses, profit, and how each product is selling. If something is not selling, try changing the wording, the price, or how you show it.
